subject: Jungle existing project mask / first PHG-style B seed
scope: Independent agent visual source-pair comparison and read-only native raster analysis. This is not human artistic approval or canonical 1:1 certification.

inspections.method: tools.view_image on A and native B; Pillow alpha/dimension/hash analysis only

identityLocksObserved: Same visible three-quarter/downward head pitch and left/right orientation; no new front/profile/back invented.
Broad rounded upper cap, enclosing wide brow rim, indented cheeks and long central lower rounded faceplate remain recognizable and close to A.
Two dark perforated/mesh ocular openings remain; they were not replaced with glowing or exposed wearer eyes.
Three dark optical elements remain on the image-left temple in the same triangular housing; no new red targeting-light state.
Grey/warm steel appearance and existing wear language remain; no new ornaments, horns, vents or teeth observed.
No body, hair/dreadlocks, weapon, neck, wearer face, scene background or duplicate mask observed.

observedChanges: Cap/cheek micrograin reads slightly calmer and less contrasty.
Large reflections remain controlled, with broad readable material rather than noisy universal chrome.
Existing source palette and form remain close; the adaptation is intentionally restrained.
phgDirectionAssessment.doNotForceLargerDifference: A already has a high-quality PBR-like rendering. A stronger stylistic contrast would risk redesigning the mask; no regeneration is recommended merely to make B look more different.

limitations: A is an exact existing project file; this review does not establish that A is an original canonical film/game asset.
Minor apparent proportion shifts remain: B visible alpha16 bounds are slightly narrower at similar height. This is not pixel-identical geometry or a certified exact copy.
Fine pits, mesh pattern and scratches have been recalculated by generation and are not exact UV/detail-map reproduction.
Raw view_image appearances are not a replacement for actual dark/light/checker browser composites; those checks remain for the pack QA.
Actual 360px and 96px rendering was not executed by this quick seed review; parent pack QA should cover it.

warnings: Native B minimum margin is37px, under5percent of1254px. It is a framing warning, with no core clipping. Do not CPU-shrink or crop.

nextUse: Suitable as the restrained family seed for B generation, while source A stays byte-preserved. Apply per-mask design/camera/palette/partial-scope locks, not the Jungle geometry or its three-optic layout to other masks.
futureFramingGuidance: For wide crests/horns request the entire bounding box within roughly75–80percent of the larger canvas axis; preserve every extremity instead of blindly filling75–80percent height. Record actual native output, do not CPU-resize.
